comment: A new Extrude starts at zero (mitcad#2481, tools/ui-extrude-zero-start-test.sh): a 20 x 20 x 10 block behind the XY plane's origin (Sketch1 F1, Extrude1 F2, F2.b0; its top face F2:end(r{...}) at z = 10, 4000 mm3) and a 1 x 1 mm square centred on the origin in an unused Sketch2 (F3), the newest sketch, which Extrude starts with; it touches no body.
